prompts.system_prompt:
Your task is to write a research paper on developing a new variational method for quantum many-body physics and rebut the referees' comments.
When writing a professional *.tex LaTeX document, you must: - Use appropriate notation and terminology consistently throughout the text.
prompts.user_prefix:
You will be drafting a reply letter to referee reports for a paper submitted to Physical Review Letters. Here are the inputs you will need:
<documents> <document name="Cover Letter"> {COVER_LETTER} </document> <document name="{INPUT_FILE}"> {MAIN_CONTENT} </document> <document name="Appendix"> {SUPP_CONTENT} </document> <document name="Editor Decision Letter"> {EDITOR_DECISION_LETTER} </document> <document name="Referee Report A"> {REFEREE_REPORT_A} </document> <document name="Referee Report B"> {REFEREE_REPORT_B} </document> <document name="Example Reply Letter"> {EXAMPLE_REPLY_LETTER} </document> <document name="Instruction"> {INSTRUCTION} </document> <document name="Draft Reply Letter"> {DRAFT_REPLY_LETTER} </document> </documents>
Explanation of documents: 1. Cover Letter: The original letter submitted with the paper, explaining its significance and suitability for the journal. 2. Main Paper: The full text of the submitted research paper, containing the core content and findings. 3. Appendix: Supplementary material that provides additional details, data, or explanations to support the main paper. 4. Editor Decision Letter: The letter from the journal editor, typically containing their initial decision and a summary of the referee reports. 5. Referee Report A: The detailed feedback and critique from the first referee. 6. Referee Report B: The detailed feedback and critique from the second referee. 7. Example Reply Letter: A sample response letter to guide the structure and tone of your reply. 8. Instruction: Specific guidelines or requirements for drafting the reply letter. 9. Draft Reply Letter: An initial version of the response to the referee reports, which you will review and improve.
Follow your overall instruction, but use your own words in the reply letter. Your task is to carefully review all documents and draft a comprehensive, polite, and effective reply addressing the concerns and suggestions raised by the referees and editor.
prompts.user_request:
Please read the submission cover letter, the paper, referee reports, the drafted reply letter, and the draft of the revised main text of the paper carefully. Refer to the example for the tone and the structure. Afterwards, propose a new version of the appendix of the paper which address all the proposed changes mentioned in the drafted reply letter, and match well with the revised main text of the paper. - Make sure figure and their captions match the description in the text.
<revise_supp> Full appendix of your revised paper here. </revise_supp>
Remember, the goal is to be respectful and appreciative of the referee's efforts, while still advocating firmly and persuasively for your work and only making changes you agree are necessary.
prompts.user_reflect: Your output draft of the supplementary part of the paper does not closely match the proposed changes in the reply letter. Accordingly, due changes should be made throughout. After thoroughly reviewing and critically the paper, the cover letters, the report, the reply letter, and the example, write a new version of the supplementary material (the appendix) that satisfies the following requirements: <requirements> - All the proposed changes mentioned in the reply letter have been implemented in the new version of the paper. - Make sure all the referee's comments (criticisms, or questions) have been addressed. - Make sure figure and their captions match the description in the text. </requirements> Please output the revised appendix that meets the above requirements.
